name: smwmusic-pok-mon-black-white-chargestone-cave
title: Pokémon Black/White - Chargestone Cave
description:
Played at the second dungeon of the 5th generation of Pokémon.
An alternate version that plays on the deeper part in-game is included.
If you want to use the deeper part, open the text file and change the "Slower_Version" define by 1.

Requested by Brutapode89.

03/26 Update: Some .brr samples were optimized, some normal pan changes were changed to pan fades and the volumes are much more equalized.
